title: المسائل الإسلامية

official_digital_text_leads.assessment: Official library page indexed with Arabic text, but automated retrieval redirects in a loop. Completeness and a stable machine-readable endpoint were not established.
Official announcement says complete Arabic text was published, but it does not itself establish an extractable, complete source endpoint.

pdf_diagnosis.visible_page_assessment: Representative rendered body pages are readable Arabic.
failure_signals: Private-use glyphs such as U+F04B/U+F031/U+F043 are emitted instead of Arabic text.
Many body pages extract only whitespace or dot leaders despite containing visually readable Arabic.
Extracted non-empty pages contain malformed glyph sequences and punctuation garbage.
pdf_diagnosis.diagnosis: The PDF's visual glyphs are not backed by a reliable Unicode text mapping for the extraction path. It is not safe to use its embedded text as religious evidence.

ocr_pilot.engine: Apple Vision VNRecognizeTextRequest, Arabic, accurate mode
ocr_pilot.second_engine: Not installed; no second reliable Arabic OCR engine was available in the local toolchain. Tesseract packages are discoverable but were not installed for this bounded pilot.

manual_comparison.reason: Visible text on clear pages is readable, but Vision output contains observable transcription errors (including a title-word misrecognition and a Latin character inserted into Arabic). A single-engine OCR result cannot be trusted as fatwa/ruling evidence without validated second-engine agreement and page-level review.

changes.change: Ignore whitespace controls such as normal newlines and tabs; still reject non-whitespace Cc/Cs characters.
changes.rationale: Normal line breaks were creating false positives in every structured text/OCR sample.

changes.change: Detect only ASCII digits embedded in Arabic words.
changes.rationale: Arabic-Indic numerals in normal numbered rulings (for example, المسألة ٣١٠) are valid content, while the known corrupt form الأ6سباب remains rejected.

classification.A_official_digital_text: candidate found, not verified as complete/extractable
classification.B_ocr_recoverable: possible, but not accepted from the one-engine pilot

next_safe_step: Obtain a stable official HTML/text or e-book endpoint, or run a two-engine OCR pilot followed by human page-level verification before any source is added to a staging corpus.
